### `ai_shop_coupons`

Coupon entity - This implements the 'Digital Coupons & Campaign Codes' requirement from the Discount and Payment System requirements. Represents all coupons (single-use, multi-use, stackable or exclusive) available for promotional campaigns, targeted offers, or seller-specific deals. Maintains 3NF compliance. For example, a campaign might generate 10,000 unique coupon codes, all tracked here.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique coupon identifier for lifecycle management, audit, and traceability.
- `ai_shop_promotion_id`: Related promotion's [ai_shop_promotions.id](#ai_shop_promotions). Nullable if coupon is not part of a campaign.
- `code`: Coupon code string (unique).
- `type`: Coupon type (e.g., 'single_use','multi_use','stackable','exclusive').
- `description`: Human-friendly explanation of the coupon.
- `valid_from`: Coupon validation start datetime.
- `valid_until`: Coupon expiration datetime.
- `max_uses`: Maximum total uses before expiration.
- `max_uses_per_customer`: Maximum uses per customer.
- `min_purchase_amount`: Minimum order amount for coupon redemption.
- `discount_amount`: Absolute discount (e.g., $5 off) or null if only percent.
- `discount_percent`: Discount percent (e.g., 10.0 for 10%).
- `is_active`: Current activation status.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last updated timestamp.

### `ai_shop_coupon_assignments`

Coupon Assignment entity - Implements the requirement 'Assignment, Tracking, Usage Logging' for coupons. Tracks which customer (or entity) has received, claimed, or used a specific coupon. Maintains 3NF by separating assignment and usage from coupon definition. For example, a user redeeming a code will have a row here.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key for uniquely identifying each coupon assignment event.
- `ai_shop_coupon_id`: Assigned coupon's [ai_shop_coupons.id](#ai_shop_coupons).
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Assigned or claiming customer's [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers).
- `ai_shop_order_id`: Order's [ai_shop_orders.id](#ai_shop_orders) where the coupon was applied.
- `assigned_at`: Timestamp when coupon assigned to customer.
- `redeemed_at`: Nullable redemption timestamp.
- `state`: Assignment state ('assigned', 'redeemed', 'expired', etc.).

### `ai_shop_promotions`

Promotion/Campaign entity - Implements the 'Promotion Campaign, Bulk Coupon Creation, and Event Management' requirements. Tracks all coupon campaigns, automatic promotions, manual or AI-driven sales events that govern coupon logic and presentation. Each campaign can generate multiple coupon codes linked via ai_shop_coupons.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Each campaign/promotion's unique identifier.
- `name`: Promotion title (e.g., 'Summer 2025 Campaign').
- `description`: Human-friendly explanation.
- `type`: Promotion type ('bulk_coupon', 'auto_discount', 'event', etc.).
- `start_at`: Campaign start timestamp.
- `end_at`: Campaign end timestamp.
- `is_active`: Whether the campaign is enabled and visible.
- `created_at`: Campaign creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for campaign.

### `ai_shop_deposits`

Deposit entity - Implements 'Customer/Seller Deposit Tracking and Balance Ledger'. Represents non-withdrawable or redeemable credits in the platform, viewable and manageable per-user. Maintains 3NF. For example, a single credit purchase transaction appears as a row in this table.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique deposit ledger entry.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Customer making the deposit.
- `ai_shop_seller_id`: Seller beneficiary for this deposit (nullable).
- `ai_shop_order_id`: Order associated with this deposit (nullable).
- `type`: Deposit line type: 'credit','debit','reward', etc.
- `amount`: Deposit transaction amount.
- `description`: Optional transaction note.
- `created_at`: Ledger entry creation timestamp.

### `ai_shop_mileages`

Mileage entity - This implements the 'Mileage Points Tracking' requirement for discount and loyalty. Tracks all atomic accrual or deduction transactions for the mileage (point, loyalty) system tied to a specific customer.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each mileage transaction entry.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Customer earning or spending mileage points.
- `ai_shop_order_id`: Order linked to mileage flow (earning/redeeming). Nullable.
- `type`: Mileage transaction type: 'earn','redeem','adjust','expire', etc.
- `amount`: Change in mileage points (positive or negative).
- `description`: Optional note for the points event.
- `created_at`: Transaction timestamp.

### `ai_shop_donation_coupons`

Donation Coupon entity - Implements the requirements for 'Donation-Linked Coupon Tracking' and compliance with charity-linked transactions. Represents specialized coupons whose use generates (or is funded by) charitable contributions. Normalized to atomic value and relationship per company compliance requirements.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each donation-related coupon entry.
- `ai_shop_coupon_id`: Coupon involved in the donation.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Customer who used the coupon (donor).
- `ai_shop_order_id`: Related order (if the donation is tied to a purchase). Nullable.
- `amount_donated`: Monetary value of donation linked to this coupon redemption.
- `donation_type`: Donation linkage type (e.g., 'seller_funded','platform_match','customer_opt_in').
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for audit trails and compliance.

### `ai_shop_inquiries`

Inquiry Entity - Implements the core inquiry requirements from the AI Shop Inquiry and Review System requirements analysis (see ERD section). 

This model represents individual product or order inquiries written by customers. It is fully normalized with a direct relationship to the customer making the inquiry and optional linkage to a specific product. Maintains 3NF by only including inquiry-specific attributes; replies and moderation are handled in separate, related tables. Example: A customer submits a question about a product, tracked here for workflow, analytics, and future reference.

Key relationships: belongs to a customer (foreign key to ai_shop_customers) and may reference ai_shop_products. All replies, ratings, and moderation are tracked outside of this entity. 
Special behaviors: Each inquiry is immutable for audit logging, and moderation actions are independently tracked.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each inquiry.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Referenced customer's [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers). Indicates the customer who wrote this inquiry.
- `ai_shop_product_id`: Target product's [ai_shop_products.id](#ai_shop_products) this inquiry is about, if any.
- `title`: Title of the inquiry - Implements requirement for clear subject line. This field provides a concise indicator of inquiry content for listing, search, and indexing.
- `body`: Inquiry content/body - Main question or statement posed by the customer. Normalized as atomic text.
- `status`: Inquiry status - Implements workflow requirement. Indicates open, resolved, or closed state, used in moderation and escalation flows. Example: 'open', 'answered', 'closed'.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the inquiry was created. Required for audit trail and ordering.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update (if any). For mod tracking and data freshness monitoring. Null when never updated.

### `ai_shop_inquiry_replies`

Inquiry Reply Entity - Implements the need for threaded, multi-seller/admin/customer responses to inquiries per requirements and ERD. 

This model is 3NF compliant and stores individual replies to an inquiry, including support for nested replies (threading) via self-referencing parent_id. It allows both sellers and admins to engage customers transparently. 

Key relationships: References ai_shop_inquiries (parent inquiry), ai_shop_sellers, ai_shop_admins; supports hierarchy via parent_id for infinite threading. Usage example: Seller answers a question, followed by further clarification threads.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each reply.
- `ai_shop_inquiry_id`: Parent inquiry's [ai_shop_inquiries.id](#ai_shop_inquiries) this reply references.
- `ai_shop_seller_id`: Seller user [ai_shop_sellers.id](#ai_shop_sellers) who wrote the reply, if reply is from a seller.
- `ai_shop_admin_id`: Admin user [ai_shop_admins.id](#ai_shop_admins) who wrote the reply, if reply is from an admin.
- `parent_id`: Self-reference for threaded replies (parent reply). Allows for hierarchical, nested threading of responses.
- `body`: Reply content/body - Core reply message. Implements business rule for atomic, auditable communication.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this reply was made. For chronological ordering, moderation, and SLA measurement.

### `ai_shop_reviews`

Review Entity - Implements the customer product review requirements (see Inquiry & Review requirements and ERD). 

This fully normalized model represents a single customer review on a product, with atomic fields for content, rating score, and extensive linkage to customer and product. Snapshots for moderation/history are tracked separately. 

Compliance: 3NF strictly maintained (no pre-aggregations/denormalizations). Usage example: Customer writes a review for a purchased product, which is then subject to moderation/rating workflows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the review.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Customer [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers) who wrote the review.
- `ai_shop_product_id`: Product [ai_shop_products.id](#ai_shop_products) being reviewed.
- `body`: Review content/body. The normalized text of the review. Example: Customer's feedback.
- `rating`: Star rating assigned by the customer. Integer value, typically 1-5. Enforces business logic for star-based rating systems.
- `status`: Moderation or publication status (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'). Used in system workflows to separate public/pending reviews.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when review is written. Supports analytics/audit trail.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last edit. Nullable if never updated.

### `ai_shop_review_moderations`

Review Moderation Record - Implements review moderation flow (see Inquiry & Review System acceptance criteria). Tracks all moderation actions, linking reviews, admins, and logs. 

Each moderation record is created per action and is fully normalized, separated from review content itself. Enables full audit, compliance tracing, and snapshotting.

Key relationships: References ai_shop_reviews (target), ai_shop_admins (actor/admin), and includes moderation decision, notes, and timestamp. Example: Admin flags or approves a review after AI or human check.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique moderation action record.
- `ai_shop_review_id`: Target review's [ai_shop_reviews.id](#ai_shop_reviews).
- `ai_shop_admin_id`: Admin actor [ai_shop_admins.id](#ai_shop_admins) who took moderation action.
- `action`: Moderation action ('approve', 'reject', 'flag'). Maps to business rules for platform compliance.
- `reason`: Reason for moderation action. Ensures all actions are auditable and justified. Example: 'Spam', 'Abusive language'.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of moderation action; ensures traceability and audit compliance.

### `ai_shop_review_ratings`

Review Helpful/Helpfulness Rating - Implements atomic, per-user (customer) ratings of reviews' helpfulness per requirements document.

Each record logs a single customer's upvote/downvote (e.g., 'helpful' or not) on a specific review, meeting requirements for engagement tracking and feedback loops. Enforces 3NF by storing only atomic user-review vote; any aggregation is handled externally. 

Key relationships: References ai_shop_reviews and ai_shop_customers for each vote instance. Example usage: Customer marks a review as 'helpful', supporting review ranking and display.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique instance of review rating/vote.
- `ai_shop_review_id`: Target review's [ai_shop_reviews.id](#ai_shop_reviews) being rated.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Customer [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers) giving the helpfulness rating.
- `helpful`: Helpfulness indicator (true for helpful, false for not). Implements binary upvote/downvote pattern per requirements.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the helpfulness vote was registered. Enables feedback recency tracking and abuse mitigation.

### `ai_shop_inquiry_moderations`

Inquiry Moderation Record - Implements moderation tracking requirements for customer inquiries, meeting audit and platform compliance business imperatives.

Each record reflects a moderation action performed by an admin on a specific inquiry, separately from the inquiry content itself. 3NF is maintained by avoiding denormalized outcomes— snapshots and aggregate data managed elsewhere. 

Key relationships: Connects the moderated inquiry, the acting admin, and logs specific action/reason.
Example: An admin flags a question as inappropriate, records action and rationale for audit.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique moderation action instance.
- `ai_shop_inquiry_id`: Moderated inquiry's [ai_shop_inquiries.id](#ai_shop_inquiries).
- `ai_shop_admin_id`: Admin [ai_shop_admins.id](#ai_shop_admins) performing the moderation.
- `action`: Moderation action type (e.g., 'approve', 'flag', 'delete'). Mirrors business logic for workflow transitions.
- `reason`: Justification for moderation action. Required for compliance/audit. Example: 'Off-topic', 'Spam', etc.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of moderation action.

Inquiry favorites entity - Implements feature for favoriting customer service/product inquiries. Allows users to bookmark inquiries (e.g. product Q&A, support tickets). - `ai_shop_customer_id`: Owner's [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers). Links the favorite to the user for dashboard sorting and audit trails.

### `ai_shop_favorites_addresses`

Address favorites entity - Fulfills the requirement of favoriting frequently-used shipping or billing addresses. Lets customers quickly access preferred addresses for checkout. Maintains 3NF so that each favorite relates singularly to a customer and an address record with timestamped history. For example, during checkout, a user can select a saved favorite address.

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the address favorite entry.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Owner's [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers). Establishes which user owns this address favorite.
- `ai_shop_profile_id`: Reference to user's [ai_shop_customer_profiles.id](#ai_shop_customer_profiles). Points to the address profile, separating favoriting logic from profile data for normalization.
- `created_at`: Timestamp for when this favorite entry was created, for analytics and sorting.

### `ai_shop_favorites_notifications`

Notification favorites entity - Implements the feature for favoriting platform/campaign notifications. Allows users to save important notifications for future reference (promo or transactional alerts). Achieves 3NF by keeping notification favoriting records atomic, separated from notification content or delivery log. For example, a notification about a sale can be favorited and shown in a priority section.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the notification favorite entry.
- `ai_shop_customer_id`: Belonged customer's [ai_shop_customers.id](#ai_shop_customers). Indicates the favoriting user, for tracking and personalization.
- `ai_shop_notification_id`: ID of the notification favorited. Business semantic: References the favorited notification. No enforced FK because ai_shop_notifications table does not exist.
- `created_at`: Datetime for when the favorite was added. Used for sorting, auditing, and personalization.

parameters.description: PK of the favorite address mapping to update (ai_shop_favorites_addresses.id).

requestBody.description: New values for ai_shop_customer_id and/or ai_shop_profile_id to update the mapping. Only these fields are writable.

responseBody.description: The updated ai_shop_favorites_addresses mapping object.

operations.specification: Deletes a single favorite address record from ai_shop_favorites_addresses, removing the mapping between the customer and the favorited address/profile. Table fields: id (PK), ai_shop_customer_id (FK), ai_shop_profile_id (FK), created_at (timestamp). There is no deleted_at or soft-delete support; the record is physically deleted from the database by this operation. This permanently erases the user's favorite mapping to a given address/profile and cannot be undone. Cascade effects to customer or profile data do not occur.
operations.description: Permanently deletes a favorite address relationship by primary key ID from ai_shop_favorites_addresses. As the schema has no soft delete or archival field, the row is removed completely. The operation is only permitted for the owning customer or authorized admin. If the provided ID does not exist, a not-found error is returned. This operation is idempotent: repeated calls with the same ID after deletion have no effect. No related records (customer, profile) are modified or deleted. Proper access and ownership checks enforced.
operations.summary: Permanently (hard) delete a favorite address record by ID from ai_shop_favorites_addresses.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Primary key of the ai_shop_favorites_addresses record to be deleted.

operations.specification: Fetches a paginated, filterable list of favorited notifications linked to a given user. This endpoint operates on ai_shop_favorites_notifications (fields: id (PK), ai_shop_customer_id (FK), ai_shop_notification_id (domain notification), created_at (timestamp)). No soft delete or state columns—exists if favorited. Used to display all notifications a user has bookmarked/saved. Output includes only the relationship metadata, not the notification content or push details. Filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters may include customer_id, notification_id, or created_at. Owner-only access enforced.
operations.description: Retrieves a list of records from ai_shop_favorites_notifications, representing notifications a user has favorited. Each row includes: id (unique favorite relationship), ai_shop_customer_id (user), ai_shop_notification_id (domain notification being favorited), created_at (addition timestamp). The endpoint restricts visibility to the owner. Only atomic relationship data is returned—actual notification content should be resolved externally. Pagination, filtering, and sorting supported by input fields. No soft-delete; the favorite exists or does not.
operations.summary: Get paginated/filtered list of favorited notifications for a user from ai_shop_favorites_notifications.

requestBody.description: Filter, search, and pagination criteria for querying favorite notification entries.

responseBody.description: A pageable or filterable collection of ai_shop_favorites_notifications links between user and notification.

operations.specification: Retrieves a favorite notification mapping by its unique ID from ai_shop_favorites_notifications. Table columns: id (PK), ai_shop_customer_id (FK), ai_shop_notification_id (arbitrary notification PK), created_at (timestamp). No archival or soft delete—mapping either exists or not. Used to show if a specific notification has been favorited by a given customer or to display favorite link creation date. The notification content itself is NOT returned. Typically, only the owning user or admin can access this record.
operations.description: Get a favorite notification entry from ai_shop_favorites_notifications by its primary key. Returned data contains: id (row PK), ai_shop_customer_id (user), ai_shop_notification_id (notification being favorited), created_at (timestamp of bookmarking). This endpoint does not resolve or expose notification details—only the favorite relationship metadata. Used for UI logic (e.g., highlight as favorited). Only the owner user or authorized admin is allowed access.
operations.summary: Retrieve a favorite notification mapping from ai_shop_favorites_notifications by ID, returning mapping metadata.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PK of the favorite notification link (ai_shop_favorites_notifications.id).

responseBody.description: The ai_shop_favorites_notifications record that maps between user and notification.

operations.specification: Creates a new favorite notification linkage between a customer and a notification they wish to bookmark/save. Inserts a row into ai_shop_favorites_notifications with the required columns: ai_shop_customer_id (FK), ai_shop_notification_id (PK of notification being favorited), created_at (insert timestamp, can be supplied or defaulted by DB). Table is strictly normalized; no extra or state/archival columns. Duplicates (by customer, notification) blocked by unique constraint. Output is the newly created link; no notification content returned. Proper authentication required.
operations.description: Accepts a create request to add a customer-notification favorite mapping in ai_shop_favorites_notifications. Input fields: ai_shop_customer_id (customer), ai_shop_notification_id (notification), created_at (if provided; otherwise current time). Output is the favorite relationship or error on duplicate, invalid reference, or unauthorized. No soft delete or additional metadata—atomic linkage. Only owner user or admin may create. No actual notification data returned.
operations.summary: Create a new favorite notification link between customer and notification in ai_shop_favorites_notifications.

requestBody.description: Input data to create a new ai_shop_favorites_notifications row (customer, notification IDs).

responseBody.description: Resulting ai_shop_favorites_notifications favorite link record for user and notification.

operations.specification: Updates an existing favorite notification record in ai_shop_favorites_notifications, identified by PK. Only ai_shop_customer_id and ai_shop_notification_id fields can be modified (no state/archival fields exist). No address or content resolution—pure mapping update. Uniqueness of (customer, notification) enforced. Ownership and authorization required, ensuring users can update only their own mappings. created_at remains unchanged. Returns updated object. No soft-delete exists; absence of record implies non-favorited notification.
operations.description: Updates ai_shop_favorites_notifications row with new customer and/or notification ID, based on the given PK. Only updatable columns: ai_shop_customer_id and ai_shop_notification_id. created_at timestamp is not writable. Must ensure unique constraint is not violated and only the owner may update. Endpoint returns the edited favorite mapping. No cascades or effects on notifications or users beyond updating this favorite link. Errors: not found, forbidden, unique violation.
operations.summary: Update a favorite notification relationship by ID in ai_shop_favorites_notifications (customer, notification mapping).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PK value for the favorite notification mapping (ai_shop_favorites_notifications.id).

requestBody.description: New mapping values (ai_shop_customer_id and/or ai_shop_notification_id).

responseBody.description: The updated ai_shop_favorites_notifications favorite notification link record.

operations.specification: Permanently deletes a favorite notification mapping by unique ID from ai_shop_favorites_notifications. The schema includes: id (PK), ai_shop_customer_id (FK), ai_shop_notification_id (notification/entity PK), created_at (timestamp). No deleted_at or soft delete, so the delete is a hard removal. Only the explicit mapping row is affected. After deletion, the notification will not be marked as favorited for the user. No notification content or user record alteration occurs. Access and authorization must restrict operation to the owner or admin.
operations.description: Removes favorite notification mapping for a user and notification by row ID from ai_shop_favorites_notifications via hard delete. This is a physical removal, as soft delete or archived state does not exist in the schema. Only the owner may remove their own notification favorites, or an admin with suitable permissions. Related notification or customer records are not altered. Errors: not found, forbidden (unauthorized). No cascade operations.
operations.summary: Permanently delete a favorite notification mapping by ID from ai_shop_favorites_notifications (hard delete, no soft-delete).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PK for the favorite notification mapping row to delete.

IAiShopInquiry.IUpdate.description:
업데이트용 문의 엔티티 객체(IAiShopInquiry.IUpdate)로, ai_shop_inquiries에 정의된 필드만을 포함해 업데이트 요청에 사용한다.

업데이트 가능한 필드는 제목(title), 본문(body), 상태(status), 참조곡 ai_shop_product_id 등이 있으며, 모두 스키마에 명시된 것들이다. deleted_at 등 소프트 삭제 관련 필드는 존재하지 않는다. 대부분의 필드는 선택적으로 제공 가능하며, id는 경로 파라미터로 전달된다. 본 타입은 PUT 요청 Body에 사용된다.

title.description:

예시: '배송 지연 관련 문의', '상품 사이즈 문의' 등.

body.description:

예시: '상품이 언제 출고되는지 궁금합니다.'

status.description:

상태에 따른 비즈니스 규칙에 따라 처리된다.

상품 선택형 문의가 아니면 null로 둘 수 있다.

IPageAiShopConfiguration.description:
Paginated response type containing configuration entries as returned from list/search queries. Each page includes metadata (size, current page, etc) and a list of ai_shop_configuration records.

Links to IPage.IPagination for metadata and schema-compliant configuration records.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each configuration parameter (UUID).

param_name.description: Configuration parameter name. Implements atomic, normalized key/value store of platform configuration. Example: 'max_cart_size', 'maintenance_mode'. Unique.

param_value.description: Value for the configuration parameter. May be stringified JSON for complex settings. Example: 'true', '50', '{"allowed":true}'.

oneOf.description: Optional human-readable description of what this config controls. Assists admin understanding, auditing. Example: 'The maximum number of items allowed in a cart.'

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what this config controls. Assists admin understanding, auditing. Example: 'The maximum number of items allowed in a cart.'

created_at.description: Timestamp when configuration was created. Enables auditing, rollback, compliance.

updated_at.description: Last updated timestamp for audit and synchronization.

IAiShopConfiguration.description:
Represents a single platform configuration parameter as defined in the ai_shop_configurations table. Each row is a name-value pair (sometimes with JSON value), and may have human-readable explanation and audit dates.

Mapped directly to the ai_shop_configurations schema, enforcing 3NF storage for dynamic settings. Used throughout platform for dynamic/feature flag system control.

param_name.description: Configuration parameter name. Must be unique for each record. Used as the atomic key for config lookup.

param_value.description: The value for the configuration parameter (may be string or stringified JSON).

oneOf.description: Optional human-readable explanation of parameter purpose.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of parameter purpose.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp. Set automatically if not supplied.

updated_at.description: Last modified timestamp. Set automatically or equals created_at on insert.

IPageAiShopFiles.title: IPageAiShopFiles
IPageAiShopFiles.description:
A paginated page of AI Shop file metadata records, corresponding to the ai_shop_files table in the systematic context. This is the standard IPage container pattern used throughout the system, parameterized for ai_shop_files row schema objects.

Includes pagination metadata (current page, limit, total records/pages) and an array of file objects, each representing a single uploaded file's metadata in the AI Shop ecosystem. All properties and structure strictly follow the IPage pattern, referencing ai_shop_files for file entries.

See Systematic/File upload management requirements and System Architecture docs for usage and audit scenarios.

data.description: Array of ai_shop_files objects for the current page, with all metadata fields defined in the schema.

IAiShopFiles.title: IAiShopFiles
IAiShopFiles.description:
AI Shop File metadata object, representing an individual uploaded file as stored in the ai_shop_files DB table. This type records all physical metadata about an uploaded file for the AI Shop system (across posts, products, attachments, etc). Strictly normalized, non-duplicative storage per Systematic/file DB table schema. Each field aligns with a column in the DB, facilitating precise file tracking, quota, preview, or download.

Used in admin, upload, product, bulletin, or attachment flows. See @namespace Systematic, ai_shop_files in the Prisma schema.

original_name.description: Original file name as uploaded, for UI/admin display (e.g., 'invoice2025.pdf').

uri.description: Persistent storage URI or path (e.g., cloud url, s3 key). Unique per file, used for direct programmatic retrieval.

mime_type.description: File mime type (e.g., 'image/png', 'application/pdf'). Used for content previews and validation.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Used for quota enforcement, auditing, upload display.

oneOf.description: Name of uploader if known at upload time, for audit, attribution, or internal display.
Name of uploader if known at upload time, for audit, attribution, or internal display.

uploader_name.description: Name of uploader if known at upload time, for audit, attribution, or internal display.

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp for when file was uploaded. Used in audit, regulatory, and data retention calculations.

IAiShopProductVariants.IUpdate.description:
모든 필드는 ai_shop_product_variants 테이블의 실제 컬럼을 반영합니다.

제품 옵션(variant)을 부분/전체 수정할 때 사용합니다. 필드는 다음과 같습니다:
- ai_shop_product_id: 부모 상품의 UUID (필수)
- sku: 옵션 결합을 식별하는 고유 문자열 (필수)
- option_combo: 예시 "Color:Red;Size:L" (필수)
- barcode: 바코드(선택)
- is_active: 판매 가능 여부 (필수)

업데이트 시, 존재하지 않는 값은 에러가 발생합니다. 모든 property는 실제 Prisma DB 컬럼 설명을 그대로 따릅니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
부모 상품(UUID)입니다. ai_shop_products.id를 참조하며, 어떤 상품의 옵션조합인지를 명확히 합니다.

Prisma 스키마: ai_shop_product_variants.ai_shop_product_id

반드시 존재하는 상품 UUID이어야 하며, 변경 시 해당 옵션이 다른 상품에 귀속될 수 있습니다.

sku.description:
이 옵션의 재고관리 고유 식별자(SKU). 반드시 제품+옵션조합별로 고유합니다.

예: 'SKU-BAG-RED-L'

Prisma 스키마: ai_shop_product_variants.sku

SKU 중복 시 인서트/업데이트 에러가 발생합니다.

option_combo.description:
옵션 결합을 나타내는 원자적 string. 예: 'Color:Red;Size:L'.

제품 옵션의 조합(색상·사이즈 등)을 문자열로 직렬화한 값입니다.

Prisma 스키마: ai_shop_product_variants.option_combo

상품 버전 스냅샷(ai_shop_product_snapshots) 신규 레코드 생성에 필요한 DTO. 모든 required property들은 Prisma DB 컬럼 그대로 1:1로 작성됨.

- ai_shop_product_id (UUID, 필수)
- name (string, 필수)
- description (string, 필수)
- category_id (UUID, 필수)
- status (string, 필수)
- created_at, updated_at (UTC ISO8601, 시스템 자동 또는 직접입력)

상품 변경이력, 롤백, 감사를 위한 완전한 버전 정보 기록용입니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description: 스냅샷 작성 대상 상품의 UUID(PK of ai_shop_products)

name.description: 스냅샷 시점 상품명

description.description: 스냅샷 시점 상품 description

status.description: 스냅샷 등록 시점의 상품 상태값

created_at.description: 스냅샷 생성일시(UTC ISO8601)

updated_at.description: 생성 후 최종 변경일시.

aiShopProductSnapshots.IUpdate.description:
상품 버전 스냅샷(ai_shop_product_snapshots) 레코드 업데이트(정정/감사용) DTO.

- name, description, category_id, status, updated_at 등 Prisma DB 컬럼과 1:1 매핑.
- created_at(최초작성일)은 불변(수정 불가), updated_at은 업데이트 시 반드시 현재 UTC로 변경 필요.
- 비즈니스상, 일반적으로 immutable이지만, 예외적으로 감사용/정정용 수정 시 사용

필드 불일치나 누락은 에러를 유발합니다.

name.description: 수정/변경할 때의 상품명

description.description: 수정/변경할 때의 상품 설명

status.description: 수정 시점 상품 상태 문자열

updated_at.description: 수정 시 UTC ISO8601 변경일자

ai_shop_product_id.description:
상품 이미지가 속한 제품의 고유 식별자(Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images.ai_shop_product_id).

이 값은 특정 제품에 속한 이미지만 검색하거나 필터링할 때 사용합니다. uuid 형식에 맞게 입력해야 하며, 정확한 제품을 지정할 때 필요합니다.

alt_text.description:
이미지의 접근성 및 대체 텍스트.

검색 또는 필터링 기준의 일부로 사용될 수 있습니다. 여러 언어 또는 키워드와 함께 활용 가능합니다.

Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images.alt_text 컬럼에 해당합니다.

position.description:
이미지의 갤러리 내 순서(정수형, 1부터 시작). 

관리자 UI 등에서 정렬 또는 특정 위치 이미지만 조회할 때 사용합니다. Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images.position에 대응됩니다.

sort_order.description: 정렬 기준(예: "created_at desc", "position asc" 등). 필수 사항은 아니며, 일반적으로 admin, seller UI에서 다양한 정렬 옵션을 제공할 때 사용합니다.

aiShopProductImages.IRequest.description:
상품 이미지 목록을 조회·검색·페이지네이션할 때 사용하는 요청 DTO입니다.

Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images 테이블 필드(ai_shop_product_id, alt_text, position 등)를 기준으로 필터링 및 검색이 가능합니다. 기본적으로 페이징 처리를 지원하며, 갤러리 내 특정 제품, 순번, 접근성 텍스트 등 다양한 검색 조건을 하나의 요청 객체로 전달합니다.

data.description:
현재 페이지의 상품 이미지 레코드 목록.

각 항목은 aiShopProductImages 객체이며, Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images 테이블 1행 전체에 대응됩니다.

IPageAiShopProductImages.description:
상품 이미지 페이징 응답 객체입니다.

상품 이미지 search/list API가 반환하는 표준 페이징 타입입니다. pagination(현 페이지 정보)와 data(상품 이미지 배열)로 구성되어 있습니다.

각 이미지 객체는 aiShopProductImages 타입이며, 상세 구조와 필드는 Prisma DB 스키마를 따릅니다.

id.description:
상품 이미지 고유 식별자. Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images.id 컬럼이며, AI Shop 플랫폼 내에서 모든 이미지가 유니크하게 식별됩니다.

예시: `f3e5a790-fe34-4e8d-91e8-3b01038cca7b`

ai_shop_product_id.description:
이 이미지를 소유한 상품의 고유 식별자. `ai_shop_products.id`를 참조함.

상품에 여러 이미지를 연결하거나, 특정 상품 상세 이미지를 관리할 때 필수적인 FK입니다.

image_uri.description:
저장 또는 컷된 이미지의 퍼시스턴트 URI. DB에는 최대 80,000자로 문자열로 저장됩니다.

S3 같은 클라우드 또는 CDN 주소, 스토리지 키 등이 저장됨. 예: https://cdn.ai-shop.com/images/bag1.jpg

프론트엔드, 관리자 UI 및 모바일 등에서 해당 이미지를 렌더링할 때 이 값을 그대로 사용합니다.

alt_text.description:
이미지의 접근성(alt) 텍스트.

스크린 리더, 접근성/SEO 최적화, 대체 콘텐츠 표시에 반드시 필요.

Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_images.alt_text에 해당.

position.description:
해당 이미지의 제품 내 순서(1부터 시작).

메인 이미지, 서브이미지, 상세이미지 등 갤러리 내 위치를 결정합니다. 고유 인덱스가 부여됩니다.

aiShopProductImages.description:
상품 이미지 테이블(ai_shop_product_images)의 모든 필드를 표현하는 메인 타입입니다.

각 필드는 자세한 Prisma 스키마 컬럼 설명과 완전하게 일치하며, DB에서 row를 읽거나 단일 이미지를 조회/반환할 때 사용합니다.

포함 필드:
- id: 이미지 PK(UUID, 글로벌 고유)
- ai_shop_product_id: 부모 제품 FK(UUID)
- image_uri: 스토리지 URI(최대 8만 자)
- alt_text: 접근성 및 설명
- position: 테이블 내 unique 인덱스 및 갤러리 순서

모든 값은 NOT NULL 제약이 있으며, FK 무결성 확인이 필요합니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
이미지를 등록할 제품의 UUID(PK). 반드시 존재하는 ai_shop_products.id를 사용해야 합니다.

실제 파일/이미지 콘텐츠 업로드와는 별개로, 메타데이터만 먼저 생성하는 경우에도 필수 파라미터입니다.

image_uri.description:
스토리지 상의 이미지 고유 URI. 예: `https://cdn.ai-shop.com/images/bag1.jpg` 등 최대 8만자까지 허용.

S3, GCS, 자체 스토리지 URI 모두 가능. 반드시 상품 이미지가 업로드된 상태여야 함.

alt_text.description:
이미지의 대체 텍스트(접근성 alt). 고객/관리자/셀러가 직접 입력하며, 화면 리더 및 SEO에 활용됩니다.

상품 속성 및 제품군에 따라 고유 alt 값을 세팅해야 합니다.

position.description: 이미지 갤러리 내 노출 순번(1부터 시작). 동일 제품 내 중복 불가. 예: 1 → 대표 이미지, 2부터 서브 이미지 순.

aiShopProductImages.ICreate.description:
상품 이미지 등록(생성) 요청 시 전달되는 DTO 유형입니다.

ai_shop_product_images 테이블 컬럼 -
 - ai_shop_product_id: 상품 FK, UUID
 - image_uri: 이미지 URI
 - alt_text: 접근성 설명
 - position: 갤러리 순번

입력값은 상품의 유효성 및 중복성 체크가 필요합니다. 모든 필드는 Prisma 스키마 NOT NULL 컬럼에 대응되며, 자동 증가/생성되는 id는 제외됩니다.

image_uri.description: 업데이트할 상품 이미지의 새 URI. 서비스 마이그레이션, 재업로드 등에서 갤러리 URI가 바뀔 경우 사용합니다.

alt_text.description: 이미지 대체 텍스트(접근성 alt) 변경. 상품 정보 변경, 이미지 설명 개선 등 다양한 요청에서 수정됩니다.

position.description:
제품 내 이미지 순서 변경.

대표 이미지 전환, 상세 페이지 갤러리 내 이미지 리오더링 등에서 이 값을 갱신합니다.

aiShopProductImages.IUpdate.description:
상품 이미지를 갱신·수정하는 데 전달하는 DTO 타입입니다.

- image_uri: 클라우드/스토리지 이동, 썸네일 재생성 등에서 URI만 갱신하는 경우
- alt_text: 설명 최적화, 다국어 지원, 접근성 개선 케이스 등에서 텍스트만 수정
- position: 대표/서브 이미지 이동이나 UI 모듈 내 정렬 변경 시 값의 변화를 적용하는 필드

키(id, ai_shop_product_id)는 별도 경로/파라미터로 지정되어야 하며, IUpdate 타입에는 포함되지 않습니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
태깅할(또는 검색할) 상품의 UUID. 단일/복수 선택 모두 지원. 입력하지 않으면 전체 상품 태그 리스트에서 검색됩니다.

Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_tags.ai_shop_product_id 컬럼과 1:1로 매칭됩니다.

tag_text.description:
검색하고자 하는 해시태그 단어, 라벨.

AI Shop 내 상품 검색/필터, 대시보드 태그 추천 등에서 활용됩니다. 대소문자 구분 없음.
Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_tags.tag_text에 해당.

created_at.description:
태그 생성일로 검색. 범위형(timestamp between 씩)

예) 오늘 생성된 태그만 조회/통계 목적으로 사용함.
Prisma 컬럼 ai_shop_product_tags.created_at와 필터 가능.

sort_order.description: 정렬 기준(예: "created_at desc"). 별도 필요 시 사용.

aiShopProductTags.IRequest.description:
상품 태그 검색/리스트 요청 DTO 입니다.

Prisma 스키마의 ai_shop_product_tags 테이블 필드를 기준으로 다양한 필터, 페이징, 정렬 조건을 전달할 수 있습니다. 태킹된 상품별 태그, 생성일별, 키워드 단어별로 summay 집계, AI 추천, 대시보딩시에 활용됨.

data.description: 상품 태그 레코드들의 배열 – 각 row는 IAiShopProductTag 완전 정의형입니다.

IPageAiShopProductTags.description:
상품 태그 목록/검색 API의 표준 페이징 응답 타입입니다.

pagination: 페이지 정보,
data: 페이징된 상품 태그 레코드 배열

모든 row는 IAiShopProductTag 타입 구조입니다.

id.description:
상품 태그 고유 ID. Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_tags.id 값.

AI Shop 내 전체 태그 키의 글로벌 고유 식별자입니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
태깅 대상 상품의 고유 식별자(UUID). Prisma fk_ai_shop_product_tags_product_id와 연결됨.

상품별 태깅/검색/Ai 추천 등에 활용.

tag_text.description: 태그(해시) 텍스트. 자유형(예: '#eco', '친환경', '여름특가' 등 다양한 자연어 또는 AI 분류어). Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_tags.tag_text 컬럼에 해당.

created_at.description: 태그 생성 시점(타임스탬프). Prisma ai_shop_product_tags.created_at 컬럼 정의값과 일치함.

IAiShopProductTag.description:
상품 단일 태그의 전체 row 구조를 나타내는 타입입니다.

- id: 태그의 PK(UUID)
- ai_shop_product_id: 태깅 대상 상품 UUID
- tag_text: 해시태그/키워드
- created_at: 생성 타임스탬프

Prisma DB 컬럼과 대칭되며, row의 모든 값이 포함됩니다.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
태깅할 상품 UUID. 필수, Prisma 스키마 컬럼 ai_shop_product_tags.ai_shop_product_id.

태그 생성 시 반드시 유효한 상품 레코드가 존재해야 합니다.

tag_text.description:
생성할 태그 문자열. '#', 자연어, AI 라벨 등도 가능. Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_tags.tag_text 컬럼.

한 상품에 여러 개의 고유 태그 가능. NLP/AI 분류라벨 자동 삽입도 허용.

IAiShopProductTag.ICreate.description:
상품 태그 생성(추가) 요청 DTO.

- ai_shop_product_id: 태깅할 상품 UUID(PK,Fk)
- tag_text: 신규 태그 텍스트

프론트엔드, 관리자, AI 등에서 태그 추가 시 사용.

row id, created_at 등은 자동 생성되므로 제외.

ai_shop_product_id.description: 연결된 상품 UUID. 태그 수정 시 상품 자체 연결을 재설계할 때만 사용. 일반적으론 변경하지 않음.

tag_text.description: 수정할 태그 문자열. NLP/AI 교정, 오타, 자동 분류 수정 등에 활용.

IAiShopProductTag.IUpdate.description:
상품 태그 정보 업데이트용 요청 DTO. 보통 태그 문자열 교정, 상품 연결 변경 등에서 사용.

id, created_at 등은 수정불가며, 변화시 별도 row를 새로 만들어야 함.

ai_shop_seller_id.description:
로그 검색할 셀러의 고유 UUID. ai_shop_product_import_logs.ai_shop_seller_id 컬럼.

특정 판매자의 대량 상품 등록 내역, 실패/완료 여부 파악 등에 활용.

imported_at.description: import batch 실행 시각(범위 검색용, 예: 2025-07-21T15:00:00Z 부터 ~).

status.description:
등록 로그의 상태. `pending`, `completed`, `failed` 등.

Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_import_logs.status 컬럼: 상태별 필터링에 활용.

source_file.description:
등록 로그의 source 파일 경로/URI. S3, GCS 등 클라우드 내 import 파일 또는 서버 특정 위치 참조용.

Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_product_import_logs.source_file 컬럼.

sort_order.description: 정렬 기준(예: "imported_at desc"). 필요 시만 사용.

IAiShopProductImportLog.IRequest.description:
상품 일괄 등록 로그 import batch 목록 조회/검색용 요청 DTO.

셀러 식별, 실행 시간, 상태, source 파일 기준 등 다양한 filter 및 페이징/정렬 정보를 전달합니다. 실제 테이블 내 파티션/B bucket 검색 등 고성능 조회에 적합한 구조입니다.

data.description: 현재 페이지의 일괄 상품 등록 로그(ImportLog) 객체 배열.

IPageIAiShopProductImportLog.description:
상품 일괄 등록 import log (ai_shop_product_import_logs) 목록 API의 표준 응답 DTO.

- pagination: 페이지네이션 정보
- data: import log 레코드 리스트 배열

실제 로그 row 구조는 IAiShopProductImportLog 타입의 배열로 제공됩니다.

IAiShopProductImportLog.description: Product import log entity for recording bulk import or batch registration events for products. This model links to the seller performing the import and includes info such as timestamp, source file, record count, status (pending/completed/failed), and optional error message if failures occur. Required for audit, error tracking, and analytics. Fulfills product management requirements for tracking external or bulk upload campaigns. - ai_shop_customer_id: Customer UUID or null for guest carts—mutually exclusive with ai_shop_cart_session_id.

- status: 'active', 'abandoned', etc. as per business process.

IPageAiShopPromotions.description:
Paginated result list for AI Shop promotions (campaigns). Includes both pagination metadata and a list of promotion records. This structure follows the standard IPage pattern across the platform and refers to the business requirement for paginable campaign search in the backend marketing/coupon system.

All results provide a slice of the full promotion dataset, tied to page/limit parameters supplied in the request.

id.description: Primary key. Unique ID for a promotion campaign. As per Prisma schema ai_shop_promotions.id, this UUID is used as the reference for campaign logic, edit, and hard deletion.

name.description: Promotion title (e.g., 'Summer 2025 Campaign'). Used for display and differentiation in the admin UI and public listings. Must be unique for each start date. (ai_shop_promotions.name)

oneOf.description: Optional human-friendly explanation. Used for admin operations and customer transparency. (ai_shop_promotions.description)

description.description: Optional human-friendly explanation. Used for admin operations and customer transparency. (ai_shop_promotions.description)

type.description: Type of promotion ('bulk_coupon', 'auto_discount', 'event', etc.). Dictates campaign automation and eligibility logic. (ai_shop_promotions.type)

start_at.description: Timestamp for campaign start. ISO string, required by campaign activation logic. (ai_shop_promotions.start_at)

end_at.description: Timestamp for campaign end. ISO string, for scheduled deactivation/expiration. (ai_shop_promotions.end_at)

is_active.description: Is this campaign currently active and visible? Controls eligibility and frontend rendering. (ai_shop_promotions.is_active)

created_at.description: Campaign creation audit timestamp per ai_shop_promotions. Used for sorting/audit/history.

updated_at.description: Last campaign update timestamp per ai_shop_promotions. Required by audit trail, admin correction, and campaign dashboard.

IAiShopPromotions.description:
AI Shop promotion campaign entity, representing a discount, event, or auto-discount business event. Each row in this schema provides the core information and metadata for a campaign or event supporting the coupon and auto-promotion system.

Each field is strictly atomic and normalized, following the requirements for compliance, traceability, and multichannel compatibility. This DTO aligns to both backend and UI representations for campaign management.

name.description: Name/title of the campaign, must be unique for each starting time period. Required.

oneOf.description: Optional human-facing explanation of the campaign, for admin or customer explanation.

description.description: Optional human-facing explanation of the campaign, for admin or customer explanation.

type.description: Promotion category ('bulk_coupon', 'auto_discount', 'event', etc.). Dictates business logic.

start_at.description: Start time for the campaign (ISO date-time, e.g., '2025-06-01T00:00:00Z'). Required.

end_at.description: End time for the campaign (ISO date-time, e.g., '2025-06-30T23:59:59Z'). Required.

is_active.description: Whether this campaign is currently active and visible for eligibility and display.

IAiShopPromotions.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new promotion campaign (ai_shop_promotions) as per marketing requirements. All fields are normalized, with consistent ISO date types for scheduling. Description is optional but recommended for UX transparency and admin clarity.

name.description: Updated campaign name/title. Optional for partial update, but required for full replacement.

oneOf.description: Optional new campaign description. Can be null to clear or omitted to retain current value.

description.description: Optional new campaign description. Can be null to clear or omitted to retain current value.

type.description: Campaign type/category. Required for campaign logic. E.g., 'bulk_coupon', 'auto_discount', 'event'.

start_at.description: Updated start time of campaign (ISO 8601 string).

end_at.description: Updated end time of campaign (ISO 8601 string).

is_active.description: Whether this campaign is active for eligibility/display.

IAiShopPromotions.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a promotion campaign (ai_shop_promotions). Used for administrative campaign changes, extension of business events, or marketing schedule updates. As per requirements, all main fields are required and use atomic, normalized types. Description is optional to support legacy or minimal campaigns.

All filters map directly to atomic schema or business-analytic requirements. Designed to reflect normalized, audit-friendly backend operations.

Paginated response DTO for deposit ledger result sets. Includes both the paging metadata and an array of deposit entry objects. Used by business intelligence, audit, and user-facing account screens.

Each data entry matches the loan/deposit atomic record schema; pagination is as per IPage.

IAiShopDeposits.description: Deposit ledger record entity representing a credit/debit/loyalty event on the platform. Per ai_shop_deposits atomic schema, each row is a fully normalized accounting record for the customer (required), optionally linking to a merchant and/or order, with audit-timeliness enforced for legal reporting. Each field is precisely atomic, tied to the originating event and supporting business reconciliation. Audit, compliance, and reward flows all use this atomic structure for deposit/event analysis.

Each field is documented in the schema for external system integration and validation. Desc field is input-only for event context, not for audit trail, which is handled by audit log tables.

문의한 고객ID, (옵션:상품ID), 제목, 본문, 상태코드가 들어가며, Prisma DB 'ai_shop_inquiries' 생성조건과 일치합니다.

ai_shopIAiShopInquiry.IUpdate.description:
업데이트용 문의 엔티티 객체(IAiShopInquiry.IUpdate)로, ai_shop_inquiries에 정의된 필드만을 포함해 업데이트 요청에 사용한다.

업데이트 가능한 필드는 제목(title), 본문(body), 상태(status), 참조곡 ai_shop_product_id 등이 있으며, 모두 스키마에 명시된 것들이다. deleted_at 등 소프트 삭제 관련 필드는 존재하지 않는다. 대부분의 필드는 선택적으로 제공 가능하며, id는 경로 파라미터로 전달된다. 본 타입은 PUT 요청 Body에 사용된다.

title.description:

예시: '배송 지연 관련 문의', '상품 사이즈 문의' 등.

상태에 따른 비즈니스 규칙에 따라 처리된다.

IAiShopReviewModerations.IRequest.description:
리뷰 관리(모더레이션) 검색/목록 조회 요청 DTO입니다.

ai_shop_review_moderations 테이블에 대한 필터, 정렬, 페이지네이션 조건을 포함하며, 'admin', 'action', 'reason', 'created_at' 등 schema에 정의된 필드로 필터링이 가능합니다. 대규모 리뷰 관리/감사 대시보드, 워크플로우, 역할별 검색에 활용합니다.

ai_shop_review_id.description: 관리 대상이 되는 리뷰의 고유 ID (ai_shop_reviews.id).

ai_shop_admin_id.description: 조치(모더레이션)한 관리자(어드민)의 고유 ID (ai_shop_admins.id).

reason.description: 모더레이션 사유, 예: '부적절', '로봇 탐지', '악성 댓글', '리포트 수신' 등

limit.description: 페이지네이션: 한 페이지 반환 개수(최대 100 등)

search.description: 액션, 사유, 관리자 등 통합 텍스트 검색어

pagination.description:
Pagination information for the review moderation list.

Contains the current page, limit, total record count, and total page count for the paginated review moderation query.

data.description:
List of ai_shop_review_moderations records for the current page.

Each record contains the detailed moderation audit data for a single review moderation operation.

IPageAiShopReviewModerations.description:
A paginated result set for review moderation actions (ai_shop_review_moderations).

This result contains both the list of moderation actions for the current page and the encapsulated pagination metadata.

This schema enables consistent paginated access for admin/moderator tools and audit reporting on review moderation events.

id.description:
Primary key of the review moderation action.

Auto-generated unique identifier for each moderation record, used to reference exact audit entries in the moderation flow.

Referenced from the ai_shop_review_moderations.id column.

ai_shop_review_id.description:
Reference to the target review being moderated (foreign key to ai_shop_reviews).

This field links the moderation action to the specific product review it was taken against.

Matches the ai_shop_review_moderations.ai_shop_review_id column.

ai_shop_admin_id.description:
Reference to the admin user who performed the moderation action (foreign key to ai_shop_admins).

This records which administrator acted on the review (for compliance and audit).

Matches the ai_shop_review_moderations.ai_shop_admin_id column.

action.description:
Moderation action taken: 'approve', 'reject', or 'flag'.

This string captures the result/outcome of the moderation operation.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_moderations.action.

reason.description:
Reason or justification for the moderation action.

May include free-text explanation for the audit trail, such as 'Spam', 'Offensive Language', or policy reference.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_moderations.reason.

created_at.description:
Timestamp of when the moderation action occurred.

Indicates the audit event time for compliance records.

Matches ai_shop_review_moderations.created_at.

IAiShopReviewModerations.description:
Review moderation action entity for ai_shop_review_moderations.

Represents a single moderation event (approve, reject, flag, etc) executed by an admin on a customer review.

Auditable and immutable for compliance. Used to record moderation workflow, trace history, and compliance response to flagged or disputed reviews.

ai_shop_review_id.description:
ID of the review to be moderated (foreign key to ai_shop_reviews).

Determines which review the moderation action targets.

Must match an existing ai_shop_reviews.id value.

ai_shop_admin_id.description:
ID of the administrator taking the moderation action (foreign key to ai_shop_admins).

Indicates which admin initiated the moderation event.

Must match an existing ai_shop_admins.id value.

action.description:
Moderation action to apply: 'approve', 'reject', or 'flag'.

Determines the moderation state to set for the review.

Common values include: 'approve', 'reject', 'flag'.

reason.description:
Required justification for the moderation action, referencing the business/compliance reason or free text.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_moderations.reason column.

IAiShopReviewModerations.ICreate.description:
Payload to create a review moderation action for ai_shop_review_moderations.

Represents an auditable action by an administrator to approve, flag, or reject a specific review with required justification (reason).

Used for admin system, compliance logic, or moderation automation integrations.

action.description:
Updated moderation action value, such as 'approve', 'reject', or 'flag'.

Must be consistent with ai_shop_review_moderations.action requirements.

reason.description:
Updated moderation reason or justification, corresponding to the new moderation decision.

May be used to append further explanation to the moderation action.

IAiShopReviewModerations.IUpdate.description:
Update payload for review moderation actions (ai_shop_review_moderations).

This object allows an admin to correct, annotate, or update the moderation decision and justification for an existing moderation audit record.

ai_shop_review_id.description:
ID of the review for helpfulness voting (foreign key to ai_shop_reviews).

Used to filter or select ratings relating to a specific product review.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
ID of the customer casting the helpfulness vote (foreign key to ai_shop_customers).

Used to filter for helpfulness votes from or by a particular customer.

helpful.description:
Whether the helpfulness vote is an upvote (true) or a downvote (false).

Used to filter upvoted or downvoted review ratings.

created_at.description:
Date/time when the vote was cast.

May be used for filtering by creation window in search APIs.

IAiShopReviewRatings.IRequest.description:
Filter/search request schema for paginated listing of review helpfulness ratings in ai_shop_review_ratings.

Used in analytics dashboards and admin tools to search, filter, or sort customer helpfulness voting records.

pagination.description:
Pagination information for review ratings list.

Includes paging state, total count, and current page for the review helpfulness rating search.

data.description:
Array of ai_shop_review_ratings records listed for this page.

Each object details one customer's upvote/downvote on a specific product review.

IPageAiShopReviewRatings.description:
Paginated result set for review helpfulness ratings (ai_shop_review_ratings).

Returned by query/search endpoints to provide both current page of results and detailed pagination metadata.

id.description:
Unique primary key for a review rating record.

Maps to ai_shop_review_ratings.id—identifies one helpfulness vote.

ai_shop_review_id.description:
Product review being rated (foreign key to ai_shop_reviews).

Links vote to specific customer review.

Matches ai_shop_review_ratings.ai_shop_review_id.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
Customer providing the upvote/downvote (foreign key to ai_shop_customers).

Signifies who rated the review as helpful or not.

helpful.description:
True if the vote is an upvote (helpful), false if downvote (not helpful).

Atomic boolean for analytics, fraud prevention, and review ranking.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_ratings.helpful.

created_at.description:
Timestamp for when this rating was cast (audit/replay support).

Populated from ai_shop_review_ratings.created_at.

IAiShopReviewRatings.description:
atomic record for a single customer review helpfulness vote (ai_shop_review_ratings).

This entity records a customer marking a review as helpful (true/upvote) or not helpful (false/downvote). Used for engagement metrics, fraud/scam detection, and powering product feedback analytics.

Strictly atomic: One row per customer/review pair; multiple votes result in updating or overwriting the current record.

ai_shop_review_id.description:
The ID of the review being rated (foreign key to ai_shop_reviews).

Determines the review for which the helpfulness vote is being registered.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
The ID of the customer providing the helpfulness vote (foreign key to ai_shop_customers).

Specifies which user cast the upvote/downvote.

helpful.description:
Whether this is a positive (upvote, true) or negative (downvote, false) rating for the review.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_ratings.helpful.

IAiShopReviewRatings.ICreate.description:
Creation payload for adding a review helpfulness rating (ai_shop_review_ratings).

Represents a customer marking a review as either helpful or unhelpful.

helpful.description:
Updated boolean value for the helpfulness vote.

Set to true for upvote/helpful or false for downvote/not helpful.

Corresponds to ai_shop_review_ratings.helpful.

IAiShopReviewRatings.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for review helpfulness rating (ai_shop_review_ratings).

Allows a customer to change their previous helpful/unhelpful vote on a review.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description:
The inquiry being moderated (foreign key to ai_shop_inquiries).

Used to filter results for moderation logs of a single inquiry.

ai_shop_admin_id.description:
The administrator performing the moderation action (foreign key to ai_shop_admins).

Used to filter moderation actions by responsible moderator.

action.description:
Type of moderation action performed: 'approve', 'flag', or 'delete'.

Used to filter by moderation type.

reason.description:
Business/compliance explanation for the moderation decision.

May be used in search for logs by cause or outcome.

created_at.description:
Date/time when the moderation action was performed.

Supports search or reporting use cases for moderation event logs.

IAiShopInquiryModerations.IRequest.description:
Filter/search schema for paginated listing of inquiry moderation logs (ai_shop_inquiry_moderations).

Used in admin UI, compliance search, or moderation dashboards.

pagination.description:
Paging state information for the inquiry moderation log list.

Provides current page number, record limit, total record count, and page count.

data.description: Page of inquiry moderation actions (ai_shop_inquiry_moderations) matching the search query, for the current result set.

IPageAiShopInquiryModerations.description:
Paginated result structure for inquiry moderation logs (ai_shop_inquiry_moderations).

Used by compliance/Audit dashboards to present lists or search results for moderation actions across inquiries.

id.description:
Primary key UUID for this moderation log entry.

Unambiguously identifies the moderation action in system records.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description:
The inquiry (ai_shop_inquiries) being moderated.

Indicates which inquiry was the subject of the moderation process.

ai_shop_admin_id.description:
Reference to the administrator (ai_shop_admins) who performed the moderation.

Every moderation event logs the actor for compliance.

Maps to ai_shop_inquiry_moderations.ai_shop_admin_id.

action.description:
Type of moderation action taken (e.g., 'approve', 'flag', 'delete').

This field captures the moderation decision made on the inquiry.

reason.description:
Moderator-supplied explanation or cause for moderation.

Used in audit trails to provide compliance rationale.

Matches ai_shop_inquiry_moderations.reason.

created_at.description:
Timestamp of the moderation event (audit trail column).

Populated by system on event creation.

Maps to ai_shop_inquiry_moderations.created_at.

IAiShopInquiryModerations.description:
Entity for a single inquiry moderation event (ai_shop_inquiry_moderations).

Captures a single audit record of an admin moderation action on a customer inquiry, including actor, action, explanation, and event timestamp.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description:
Unique identifier of the inquiry being moderated. This field links the moderation action to the specific ai_shop_inquiries entity.

Reflects business requirement for audit and compliance: every moderation action must be traceable to its inquiry object.

ai_shop_admin_id.description:
Unique identifier of the admin performing the moderation action. This field establishes the responsible actor for compliance, audit, and traceability.

Corresponds directly to admin user database record and is required for accountability.

action.description:
Moderation action type that was performed. This value describes what operation took place: e.g., 'approve', 'flag', or 'delete'.

Supported values are governed by the application layer, reflecting business logic for moderation flows (approve/flag/delete).

reason.description:
Rationale or explanation for why the moderation action was taken. Required for audit, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

Example: 'Spam content', 'Off-topic', 'Abusive language'. Clarifies the context of the moderation decision.

created_at.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the moderation action was made. Required for audit trail, SLAs, and workflow timelining.

Set at creation time; not modifiable afterwards.

IAiShopInquiryModerations.ICreate.description: Creation payload for an inquiry moderation action. Required for AI Shop audit/compliance and workflow history. All fields correspond to normalized database columns and are required by business rules.

action.description: The updated moderation action (e.g., approve, flag, delete). Changing this value must be a justified business or compliance correction only; changes are audit-logged externally.

reason.description: The revised justification or annotation for the moderation action. Permitted updates only to clarify or correct moderation rationale for business/policy compliance.

IAiShopInquiryModerations.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an inquiry moderation action. Supports correction/annotation of moderation record in AI Shop system; only allowed fields per strict schema normalization.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
Unique identifier of the customer whose favorites are to be listed. Required for scoping search and enforcing access control—the result set includes only favorites for this user.

Business context: user-centered engagement, personalization, and compliance. Typically set by authentication/session context.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
Optional filter: Only favorites for a specific product. Allows targeted querying for a user's favorite status regarding a particular catalog item.

Null if not filtering by product.

created_at_before.description: Optional: Only favorites added before this ISO8601 timestamp are included. Enables historic reporting or business logic for time-dependent personalization. Null if omitted.

created_at_after.description: Optional: Only favorites added after this ISO8601 timestamp are returned. Enables querying for recent additions (e.g., for activity feeds, batch syncs). Null if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return in this page. Used for pagination and UI efficiency; default/maximum enforced at service level.

offset.description: Number of objects to skip before returning results. Used for pagination flows; default is 0.

IAiShopFavoritesProducts.IListRequest.description: Filter, query, and pagination parameters for listing product favorites in ai_shop_favorites_products. Used for personalized engagement and analytics.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata (current page, limit, records, pages). Standard format for tabular/paged API responses in AI Shop.

data.description: List of favorite product records (links between user and product) in this page of results. Each record corresponds to the strict schema normalization of ai_shop_favorites_products.

IPageIAiShopFavoritesProducts.description: Page result type for ai_shop_favorites_products record searches/listing. Bundles pagination info and product favorite records for listing endpoints.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this favorite product entry. Used for update/delete by resource.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: Owner's unique customer id. Links to the customer in ai_shop_customers.

ai_shop_product_id.description: Favorited product id. Links to the ai_shop_products catalog table.

created_at.description: Datetime set at creation time; when product was favorited by the user.

IAiShopFavoritesProducts.description: Atomic record mapping a user's 'favorite' relationship to a product. Strictly normalized, matches ai_shop_favorites_products table for AI Shop—supports auditing, personalization, engagement scoring.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: Customer (user) adding the product to favorites. FK to ai_shop_customers.

ai_shop_product_id.description: Product that is being favorited. FK to ai_shop_products.

created_at.description: Datetime the product is favorited by the user. Set by client or system; always included for audit/analytics.

IAiShopFavoritesProducts.ICreate.description: Create payload for a new user-product favorite relation. Strictly schema-bound for compliance.

ai_shop_product_id.description:
The new product id to favorite (if moving favorite to another product). FK to ai_shop_products. 

Update only permitted for correcting user error or changing product context in business flows.

created_at.description: Update the favorited-at timestamp in audit situations (rare, business-exception only). Usually not altered except to correct for timezone/late adjustment.

IAiShopFavoritesProducts.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an existing favorite product record. Mutations are rare except for historical corrections or business exceptions; modification permitted only on defined schema fields.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: User id whose inquiry favorites are being listed. Required for owner-scoping, access control, and compliance. Must match authenticated or managed user's id.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description: Optional filter: Only return favorite entries for specified inquiry. Enables dashboard, analytics, or detail UI use cases.

created_at_before.description: Optional: Filter for favorites added before a certain ISO8601 timestamp; for cold-storage, reporting, or personal history flows.

created_at_after.description: Optional: Favorites after a certain ISO8601 timestamp only; for activity feeds or engagement analytics.

limit.description: Page size (maximum items returned). Used for UI or platform pagination flow.

offset.description: Page offset (for cursor/skip pagination). Start of this result window.

IAiShopFavoritesInquiries.IListRequest.description: Filter, query, and pagination parameters for listing inquiry favorites for a given user in ai_shop_favorites_inquiries. Used for dashboard/engagement flows.

IPageIAiShopFavoritesInquiries.description: Response schema for a paged result of inquiry favorites listing (ai_shop_favorites_inquiries records). Bundles records with pagination and metadata.

id.description: Primary key for favorite entry (id of ai_shop_favorites_inquiries).

ai_shop_customer_id.description: Customer id who favorited this inquiry (FK to ai_shop_customers).

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description: The inquiry id being favorited (FK to ai_shop_inquiries).

created_at.description: When this inquiry was favorited (audit window/engagement measure).

IAiShopFavoritesInquiries.description: Entity record mapping between a customer's favorites and a specific inquiry/question. Used for analytics, engagement, and compliance; strictly schema aligned.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: Unique ID of owner (customer/user) making this favorite.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description: Unique ID of the inquiry being favorited.

created_at.description: Datetime of action (when favorited); audit-required and set by system or client.

IAiShopFavoritesInquiries.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new user-inquiry favorite relationship; atomic per schema for full normalization and audit logging.

ai_shop_inquiry_id.description: Allows reassignment of favorite to a different inquiry (correction only, rare). FK to ai_shop_inquiries.

created_at.description: Correction of created_at for audit/engagement measurement. Only modifiable as business exception.

IAiShopFavoritesInquiries.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an inquiry favorite record; only schema-modifiable fields permitted, used for business exceptions or audit corrections.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
고객 ID입니다. 즐겨찾는 주소를 조회하는 요청에 사용됩니다. 각 고객은 여러 배송지(프로필)를 즐겨찾기로 등록할 수 있으며, 이 필드를 통해 특정 고객의 즐겨찾기 주소들만 필터링해 조회할 수 있습니다.

Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_favorites_addresses 테이블의 ai_shop_customer_id 컬럼을 참조합니다.

ai_shop_profile_id.description:
고객 주소 프로필 ID입니다. 특정 프로필(배송지)이 즐겨찾기에 추가되었는지 조회할 때 사용합니다.

Prisma 스키마 ai_shop_favorites_addresses 테이블의 ai_shop_profile_id 컬럼을 참조합니다.

created_at_from.description: 주소 즐겨찾기 추가 일자(이후)를 기준으로 필터링할 때 사용합니다. ISO8601 datetime 포맷이어야 하며, 예를 들어 특정 기간 내 추가된 주소만 조회할 때 활용합니다.

created_at_to.description: 주소 즐겨찾기 추가 일자(이전)를 기준으로 필터링할 때 사용합니다. ISO8601 datetime 포맷이어야 하며, 기간 종료 조건으로 사용합니다.

page.description: 페이지네이션 시 사용할 페이지 번호입니다. 1 이상의 값이어야 하며, 기본값은 1입니다.

limit.description: 한 페이지당 조회할 즐겨찾기 주소 개수. 최대 200까지 지정 가능합니다. 기본값은 20 등 서비스 정책에 맞게 처리하세요.

IAiShopFavoritesAddresses.IRequest.description:
즐겨찾기(배송지) 조회, 필터, 페이징 요청 DTO. 고객별, 프로필별, 기간별로 즐겨찾기 주소를 검색/조회하기 위해 사용합니다.

각 필드는 Prisma의 ai_shop_favorites_addresses와 연관되며, 고객 ID 및 주소 프로필 ID로 필터링, 추가 시점으로 기간검색, 페이지네이션을 지원합니다.

data.description: 조회된 즐겨찾기 주소 리스트입니다. 각 항목이 ai_shop_favorites_addresses 단일 레코드를 의미합니다.

IPageAiShopFavoritesAddresses.description:
페이지네이션 기반의 즐겨찾기(배송지) 주소 조회 결과 객체.

프론트엔드, 관리자 UI, 통합 데이터 서비스가 페이징 처리가 필요한 목록 조회 시 사용합니다.

id.description: 즐겨찾기 주소 고유 ID, ai_shop_favorites_addresses 테이블의 PK입니다.

ai_shop_customer_id.description:
해당 즐겨찾기 주소를 소유한 고객의 고유 ID(PK).
Prisma 스키마 참조: ai_shop_favorites_addresses.ai_shop_customer_id

ai_shop_profile_id.description:
즐겨찾기 대상으로 지정된 고객 주소 프로필 ID.
Prisma 스키마 참조: ai_shop_favorites_addresses.ai_shop_profile_id

created_at.description: 이 즐겨찾기 주소가 등록된 일시(ISO8601 포맷).

IAiShopFavoritesAddresses.description:
고객의 즐겨찾는 주소를 나타내는 단일 엔터티. 각 row가 고객 - 주소프로필 간의 favorite 관계를 나타냄.

Prisma의 ai_shop_favorites_addresses 테이블 컬럼과 직접 매핑되며, DB 단 에서 unique(customer_id, profile_id)로 관리됨.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: 즐겨찾기 주소를 추가하는 주체 고객의 고유 ID입니다. 필수이며, 외래키 제약이 있습니다.

ai_shop_profile_id.description: 즐겨찾기에 추가할 배송지(고객프로필) ID입니다. 필수이며, ai_shop_customer_profiles 테이블의 id와 연결됩니다.

IAiShopFavoritesAddresses.ICreate.description: 즐겨찾기 주소 생성(추가) 요청 DTO. 고객 및 프로필 ID만 있으면 등록 가능하며, 중복(unique) 제약이 있습니다.

ai_shop_profile_id.description: 수정 시 새로운 배송지(프로필)로 변경할 경우 사용. 기존 ai_shop_customer_id는 변경 불가.

IAiShopFavoritesAddresses.IUpdate.description: 즐겨찾기 주소 정보(주소 프로필 ID) 수정 요청 객체. PK 기반으로 수정하며, 실제 변경은 프로필 ID 교체만 가능합니다.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: 고객의 고유 ID. 본인이 즐겨찾기한 알림만 조회하도록 특정 고객으로 제한할 때 사용합니다.

ai_shop_notification_id.description: 즐겨찾기된 알림의 고유 ID. 특정 알림이 즐겨찾기에 등록되어 있는지 체크할 때 사용합니다.

created_at_from.description: 즐겨찾기 알림 추가(등록) 일자 기준 - 시작. ISO8601 datetime, 기간 필터에 활용.

created_at_to.description: 즐겨찾기 알림 추가(등록) 일자 기준 - 종료. ISO8601 datetime, 기간 필터에 활용.

limit.description: 페이지당 반환할 레코드 수. 최대 200. 기본값은 20 등 서비스 정책에 맞춤.

IAiShopFavoritesNotifications.IRequest.description:
고객의 즐겨찾기 알림(Notification) 조회, 검색, 필터, 페이징 요청 DTO.

고객ID, 알림ID, 즐겨찾기 등록기간, 페이징 옵션을 받아 필터링함.

data.description: 조회된 즐겨찾기 알림(Notification) 목록

IPageAiShopFavoritesNotifications.description: 페이지네이션/필터 기반 즐겨찾기 알림 목록 조회 응답 DTO. data는 알림 즐겨찾기 엔터티 배열.

id.description: 알림 즐겨찾기 레코드 고유 ID (PK)

ai_shop_customer_id.description: 알림 즐겨찾기를 등록한 고객의 고유 식별자 (PK, FK)

ai_shop_notification_id.description: 고객이 즐겨찾기로 지정한 특정 알림(시스템, 캠페인, 정보, 트랜잭션 등)의 고유 ID

created_at.description: 이 즐겨찾기 알림이 등록된 시각 (ISO8601)

IAiShopFavoritesNotifications.description: 고객-알림 간 즐겨찾기 관계를 나타내는 엔티티. ai_shop_favorites_notifications 테이블 row에 해당됨.

ai_shop_customer_id.description: 알림 즐겨찾기를 추가하는 고객의 ID. 필수, FK 관계 존재

ai_shop_notification_id.description: 즐겨찾기에 등록할 알림(notification)의 고유 ID. 필수, 외부 시스템/DB 참조

IAiShopFavoritesNotifications.ICreate.description: 알림 즐겨찾기 등록(추가) 요청 DTO. 고객은 자신에게 온 알림을 즐겨찾기로 지정할 수 있습니다.

ai_shop_notification_id.description: (선택) 즐겨찾기 알림을 다른 알림 ID로 변경할 때 사용.

IAiShopFavoritesNotifications.IUpdate.description: 알림 즐겨찾기 정보(알림ID) 수정 요청 DTO. PK 기반으로, 알림 ID만 교체 가능.

authorization.name: customer
authorization.description: A user who browses, registers, purchases, leaves reviews, and manages personal info. Can authenticate via API for shopping and order management.

authorization.name: seller
authorization.description: A member who is permitted to sell products, manage inventory, analyze sales metrics, handle orders, and manage product content. API authentication required for seller dashboard and shop management.

authorization.name: admin
authorization.description: Manages the backend system, oversees users and sellers, configures channels, audits logs, handles disputes, ensures compliance and business rule enforcement. API authentication mandatory for system administration.
